diagnosis.method: Agent javascript_tool probe in the same tab: dynamic import of the real PolyphonicSynth with a fresh AudioContext + AnalyserNode, noteOn(69), RMS sampled every ~30 ms.
diagnosis.conclusion: A cold AudioContext reports state 'running' with currentTime 0 before its first render quantum; output appeared ~30-64 ms later. The A02 assertion took one sample at a fixed 80 ms after keydown, which is racy on a cold context. Previous PASS runs had a warm context (contextsBeforeGesture=1). Classified as a harness timing defect, not evidence of a silent note; startup latency itself is a platform cost of lazy creation.
